verdict.rationale: Model management is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that users download pre-built llamafiles from a web page and run them by hand, and that the `--cli` flag gives a prompt interface. Nothing documents CLI commands to search, download/pull, list, or remove models, so the manual web download counts only as a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface
